description: Use when a user asks "build my home gym", "what should I buy for my garage gym with $1,500" or "full home gym for a spare room with a 7.5 ft ceiling". Give the total budget in USD and describe the space in plain words (garage, basement, spare room or apartment, ceiling height, square feet or width x length). Returns a full kit: rack, barbell, plates, bench and rubber flooring, plus adjustable dumbbells and a landmine when money is left, each chosen only from products and prices in published Strong Saga guides and checked against the ceiling and floor. Each item has its guide_url (link the user there for current prices and buy buttons), price, quantity and cost; the answer gives the total at guide prices. If the budget cannot cover a full kit, budget_too_low is true, missing names what is left out and lowest_full_kit_usd says what a full kit starts at.

budget.description: Total USD for the whole kit, e.g. 1500.

ceiling_in.description: Ceiling height in inches (8 ft = 96), if not given in space.

floor_ft.description: Free floor area as width x length in feet, e.g. 10x12, if not given in space.

space.description: The space in plain words: type (garage, basement, spare room, apartment), ceiling height and size, e.g. "garage, 8 ft ceiling, 10x12 ft" or "spare room, 7 ft 6 in ceiling, 90 sq ft".

sq_ft.description: Free floor area in square feet, if not given in space.

user_height_in.description: User height in inches, for pull-up clearance under the ceiling.

name: build_my_home_gym
title: Build my home gym (full kit)
